chapter_keywords: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 332: The Yue Sovereign Unleashes the Black Blood Blade
chapter_meta_description: The Yue Sovereign performs a forbidden blood ritual to summon the terrifying Black Blood Blade. Han Li’s formation faces its first real test. A high-stakes clash of magic and will.
og_title: The Black Blood Blade is Born!
og_description: The Yue Sovereign unleashes a forbidden, soul-eating weapon against Han Li’s formation. The battle of attrition begins.
twitter_title: A demonic blade is born. The Sovereign makes his final, desperate move.
twitter_description: Fresh from the forge of forbidden blood magic, the Black Blood Blade arrives. Can Han Li’s formation hold?

lore_anchors.definition: A forbidden, demonic weapon born from a self-harming blood ritual, activated by the user's own vitality and essence blood. It possesses a malevolent will that can absorb a cultivator's divine sense, making it a dangerous, double-edged treasure.

A cultivator's most vital life force, typically stored in the heart and tongue. Losing it permanently damages one's cultivation base and lifespan, making it a last-resort payment for powerful, taboo spells.
A cultivator's spiritual perception and willpower, extending outward from the consciousness to detect surroundings and magical energy. Forcibly absorbing or damaging it is a form of spiritual attack.

A powerful strategic defensive formation based on the Five Elements theory. Its strength lies in layered defenses, making it highly resilient against brute force, even from single, overwhelming attacks.
A one-time or limited-use magical artifact condensed into a talisman, allowing a cultivator below its actual grade to temporarily access its power. A classic high-risk, high-reward trump card.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Yue Sovereign have to hurt himself to make the blade?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In xianxia, the most powerful forbidden arts often require a "price" or sacrifice, usually the user's own vitality, blood, or lifespan. This is the Mortal Stream principle of high cost for high power; there are no cheats, only painful transactions.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why was Han Li so scared of the blade touching his divine sense?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Divine sense is an extension of a cultivator's consciousness and soul. If a demonic weapon devours it, it could permanently damage Han Li's mind, control his body, or steal his memories.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't Han Li just escape the blade's attack?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Han Li is confident in his formation. He believes its layered defenses (the Reversed Five Elements Formation) can outlast the Sovereign's suicidal charge. His plan is to endure the initial burst of power and counterattack when the enemy is weakened.
